name: Synthetic oncology screening
note:
0. The patient is 52 years old.
1. Biopsy confirmed stage III lung cancer.
2. The patient has no history of autoimmune disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Adults aged 18 years or older.
- Histologically confirmed stage III or IV lung cancer.
Exclusion Criteria:
- Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment.

name: Synthetic cardiology screening
note:
0. The patient is 67 years old.
1. Echocardiography shows a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30%.
2. Current medications include an ACE inhibitor.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Age 18 years or older.
- Left ventricular ejection fraction at or below 35%.
Exclusion Criteria:
- Known intolerance to ACE inhibitors.
